node.title: Re: File::Spec::Win32 returning different result than File::Spec when doing catfile with empty string
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: This thread and your [id://11105817|previous thread] [id://11105828|sound] to me like you're leaning towards reinventing wheels instead of using [doc://File::Spec] to its full potential. I might suggest that you explain what your algorithm is trying to do, and perhaps we can suggest a better approach.
